title: calliandra houstoniana
intro: Calliandra houstoniana, commonly known as Powder Puff or Pink Powder Puff, is a flowering plant native to Central and South America, characterized by its vibrant pink flowers resembling puffs of powder. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, antimicrobial properties, and antioxidant activity, making it a valuable remedy in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Calliandra houstoniana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
